feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 September 2026 4:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 4:25pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Strong Wind warning in operation.


##Synopsis##

Strong westerly airstream is established today, before a mid-Atlantic low tracks eastwards, driving associated frontal troughs across the Irish Sea during Friday.


##Wind##

West mainly force 5 or 6, but occasionally 7 in the far east of the area, before decreasing west or southwest 4 or 5 by dawn on Friday. Then backing and increasing south or southwest 6 or 7 later Friday morning and early afternoon, and occasionally touching gale 8 in places.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but occasionally rough in the east of the area this evening, then building more generally moderate or rough Friday afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain spreading from the west later Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but occasionally moderate in any showers, then becoming moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest force 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8, gradually decreasing southwest 6 Friday evening and west or southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Saturday. Then decreasing 4 or 5 Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate overnight into Saturday.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, clearing to the southeast of the area overnight into Saturday, becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, becoming mostly good overnight into Saturday.
